name: design
description: Phase 2 (Design) worker — at v0.6.0 six commands work: `help`, `init`, `overview`, `function`, `nfr` and `status`; the other nine are declared-not-built and labelled as such in commands/help.md, so invoking one produces nothing rather than a guess. Turns the requirement spine produced by `req` into two renderings of one truth: a Thai narrative document a client can sign, and structured JSON downstream plugin agents act on without asking a clarifying question. `status` is the loop exit condition and is deterministic by construction — it refuses to return 0 while any artifact is stale or any question with a non-empty blocks[] is open, because a green light that is not true is worse than a red one, and it always names the next command even when the answer is that a person must decide. Reads req through scripts/req-contract.mjs, the single place that knows the shape of req output, and halts with exit 2 naming the path it looked for rather than inferring a missing input. Business rules are REFERENCED as req BR-xxx@vN and non-functional requirements as req NFR-<module>-###, never re-minted, because two ids for one requirement drift apart the moment /req:change moves a version; what design adds to an NFR is the measurable number its DoD demands and req does not carry, and an NFR without one is an error rather than a warning carried forward. The single trace.design.json is rebuilt by scripts/trace-design.mjs from every design artifact present, so two commands writing it cannot delete each other edges and the graph does not depend on the order the commands ran. The trace graph is derived from the artifacts rather than hand-written, split by author so a regeneration cannot eat another plugin edges. Generated documents are never hand-edited and carry no edit-here markers; every command is idempotent, halts when a preceding step is not done, and writes nothing without --write.
